title: The Shift Below
invitation: The lift keeper was told to dry three empty harnesses.

panels.speaker: Lift keeper
panels.text: Three harnesses down. Three back up. I hung them where they told me. One was still warm at the buckle.

panels.speaker: Mara Venn
panels.text: Ivo took three injured Pokémon down on that lift. Here’s his name. In the column where you sign out a shovel.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Mara asks for a missing-person form. The keeper gives her an Equipment form. Its open circle says the Recovery Service can close the report on her behalf.

choices.label: Ask about the return signal
choices.detail: Ask for the keeper’s signed record.
choices.reply: “Three rings means they came back alive. I put that on my copy first.” The keeper slips you the R-17 counterfoil under the counter. “That’s my signature. You can leave it on.”

choices.label: Check the empty lift
choices.detail: Read the gauge and copy the load plate.
choices.reply: The platform is empty. The dial says FULL. You rub the R-17 plate and find a bright crescent where the needle has worn against its stop.

echoes.text: The keeper runs a thumbnail over the crooked gap on your rubbing. “They used our punch on the road? Hold on. I kept an old routing key.”
The keeper has heard about the light. In the next room the walker’s Growlithe is asleep with its paw wrapped. The keeper says, “While you’re here, there’s something I want you to see.”

secret.title: The Missing Quarter
secret.hint: Compare the circle at the lift with the road token rubbing.
secret.text: Turn the rubbing a quarter. The gaps line up. Beside that mark on the old key, someone printed LOWER EXIT. Under it, in pencil, is a second instruction. Do not bring to surface.

title: The Drawer Marked Released
invitation: The academy clerk has a map with Ivo’s shelter still on it.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: You hold the two maps up to the window. Under the new ink there’s a door in a place where the current map just has trees.

panels.speaker: Mara Venn
panels.text: Ivo taught the Friday class. He used to stop the match and make the kids look at what their Pokémon was looking at. His good pencil’s still here.

panels.speaker: Academy clerk
panels.text: I marked all three Released at five to three. At three I could still see their truck from this chair. Sorry. I thought you were asking who signed it. That was me.

choices.label: Hear the clerk out
choices.detail: Keep the tip between you and the clerk.
choices.reply: The clerk shuts the drawer. “L-06. Driver repeated it three times.” Mara puts away her pen. She’ll ask the ranger in person, away from the duty board.

choices.label: Copy the transfer entries
choices.detail: Keep the transfer entries and cover the clerk’s name.
choices.reply: You copy the tag numbers and L-06. The clerk stops you at the initials. “Give me until the end of my shift, would you?” Mara folds that corner in.

echoes.text: The clerk reads the lift keeper’s signature. “Wren left his name on it?” They unlock a second drawer and sit down again.
The gap on your rubbing fits the seal on the release form. The clerk tries it against two more forms. They came from different drivers.

secret.title: Released Into Custody
secret.hint: Compare the R-17 evidence with a copy of the transfer entries.
secret.text: All three Pokémon have the same tag numbers under RELEASED and LOADED. The two stamps are five minutes apart. There’s a fourth row for the surveyor. Only the tag number has been filled in.

title: Last Check-In
invitation: The duty ranger kept a tape that was supposed to be wiped.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The ranger winds back to Ivo’s call sign. Close to the mic, claws skitter across the floor of the truck.

panels.speaker: Ivo, on the recording
panels.text: Three on board. Put the little one by the heater, will you? That’s my tag on the gate. Wait. Hold the truck.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Mara puts one finger on Stop. By the kettle there are two mugs. One is still upside down.

choices.label: Ask the ranger to sign the call log
choices.reply: The ranger signs beneath L-06. “I heard him ask. I waited for the desk to confirm. By the time they called back, I could see the tail-lights from here.”

choices.label: Check the loading gate
choices.detail: Find out what the gatehouse weighed.
choices.reply: Mara frees a damp duplicate from the gatehouse clip. The scale printed the weight first. On the L-06 waybill, someone has written EMPTY right across the number.

echoes.text: Mara waits until the desk clears before she says the number. The ranger takes a tape out from behind the radio. “I was hoping somebody would ask here instead of calling in.”
The ranger finds your number in the log. Mara keeps a finger over the clerk’s folded initials until the ranger is done copying.

secret.title: Four on an Empty Truck
secret.hint: Compare the ranger evidence with the academy’s transfer copy.
secret.text: The academy released them at 2:55. Ivo called at three. After his mic goes quiet, the dispatcher says something about Lakeside. The count is four.
